name: ResearchRubrics
intro: ResearchRubrics是一个用于评估深度研究（Deep Research）能力的标准化基准。它利用大型语言模型处理开放式研究问题，并通过超过2500条由专家撰写的细粒度评分标准来评估模型的表现。该基准基于超过2800小时的人工劳动构建，包含跨领域的真实研究任务，旨在全面评估模型在事实依据、推理和表达清晰度等方面的能力。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 生成, 开放式问答, Agent任务
eval_feature: 结果导向, 思维链, 领域特定
intro_en: ResearchRubrics is a standardized benchmark for evaluating Deep Research capabilities. It leverages large language models to tackle open-ended research questions and assesses model performance using over 2,500 fine-grained scoring criteria authored by experts. Built on more than 2,800 hours of human labor, the benchmark includes cross-domain real research tasks designed to comprehensively evaluate models on factual accuracy, reasoning, and clarity of expression.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ResearchRubrics arXiv:2511.07685 Sections 3.1-3.4 and evaluation sections, cross-checked against scaleapi/researchrubrics. ResearchRubrics contains 101 open-ended single-turn deep-research prompts across nine domains and 2,593 prompt-specific criteria, usually 20-43 per task. All prompts and rubrics are human-authored without LLM seeding: one STEM-trained expert drafts, a second iteratively reviews, and a third independently finalizes them, totaling more than 2,800 hours. Criteria cover six axes, distinguish mandatory from optional requirements, and use signed importance weights. Human and model judges grade criterion adherence, including partial credit in the ternary protocol, then aggregate weighted rubric compliance and report results by domain, criterion axis, and task-complexity dimensions.
